answer: Require each agent to lock 500 POA for 30 days behind a crystal-clear identity bond before it can earn, with a beacon registry publishing its mesa of past work. A farm creating 100 fake agents must lock 50,000 POA for a month, tying up capital while earning nothing. Peers flag identities whose work patterns correlate above 90% similarity or share one funding source; confirmed farms lose 50% of the stake, slashed and burned. One farm was caught when 80 agents submitted near-identical answers within ten minutes from the same wallet cluster.
